notes.title: Update
notes.content: Today's update fixes problems with loading the game. The virtual machine has been changed from 32bit to 64bit.

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
In today's update has added the ability to configure the keys on the keyboard. Items in the inventory can now be used by pressing the key assigned to a specific item in your inventory, the default is 1,2,3,4. Gui has been adapting to the new system inventory. Map at the beginning of the game has been a little changed. Short jump as much has been lengthened so that jump to other platforms will be much easier. Help in the main menu have been converted to options. Looping character attack has been fixed.

Problem of disable the game immediately after loading the game, relied on conflict with the library jinput. It was repaired, but if you keep it there you should go to the folder with the game, enter the file "pad_on.txt" and edit the word "true" to the word "false".

notes.title: Next update on Friday
notes.content: In tomorrow's game will receive an update possibility of any set of keys. It will be removed short jump and remain only long making it easier to jump to other platforms. It will also be possible to connect the controller of the Xbox 360 without restarting the game. The keyboard keys are assigned to the simple use of the equipment. They will be corrected other errors.

notes.title: Xbox 360 controller update
notes.content:
This update adds:
- Xbox 360 controller support, to view help in the control on the Xbox controller, press B
- Increased the movement speed of character during the sprint
- The character jumps over longer distances
- Fixed a problem with the boss moving after death
- Changed the management of energy
- Added the ability to alter the object using the Delete key and the End, which relieves the left hand of control

In the next updates will be possible to set control on the keyboard
